knownTotals.note: Counts individual medal-bearing mission parts. Parts without medals (Money Lending and Other Sins I & II, We Loved Once and True I & II, Pouring Forth Oil I & III) are excluded. rdr2.org also says 18 missions. Grouped lists give 16 (gp) or 19 (gtab) - see disputes.

Excludes Money Lending and Other Sins IV, The Course of True Love I and Advertising, the New American Art I (no medal). rdr2.org and gtab list 18 story missions for Ch3 because they include Money Lending IV and/or group parts.
PowerPyx: 104 story missions have gold medals. GTABase says 105 missions have gold objectives (see disputes).
Gold Rush trophy: 70 story-mission gold medals; there are 34 spare.
DISPUTED: 100% checklist counts 104 story missions, GTABase mission list counts 110 incl. 19 optional honour missions and 1 special-edition mission. Do not enforce; see disputes.

missions.name: Outlaws from the West
goldRequirements: Take no damage during the shootout
Loot 6 or more items from Adler Ranch
Complete with at least 80% accuracy
goldTips: Fight from cover and pop out only to fire; six enemies total, including one in an upstairs window and one coming from the outhouse.
Search cupboards, nightstands, drawers and the loft for loot before leaving the ranch.
Make a manual save before the mission so you can retry; all objectives must be done in one run.

missions.name: Enter, Pursued by a Memory
goldRequirements: Kill all the wolves without taking any damage
Complete with at least 80% accuracy
goldTips: Wolves come in two waves (a few on foot, more while riding); stay on high rocks and shoot them as they approach.
Use Dead Eye to keep accuracy high; misses on the move ruin the 80%.

missions.name: The Aftermath of Genesis
missions.giver: Pearson (camp food supply) / hunt with Charles
goldRequirements: Kill each deer with one arrow
Do not spook either deer
Get a clean kill on the second deer
goldTips: Crouch and approach slowly; check wind direction with Eagle Eye so the deer do not smell you.
Use Dead Eye and aim at the head/heart so each arrow is a one-shot, clean kill.

missions.name: Old Friends
goldRequirements: Catch and hogtie Kieran within 45 seconds
Kill 3 O'Driscolls in the same Dead Eye use
Complete within 15 minutes 30 seconds
Get 15 headshots
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Equip the lasso and sprint immediately when the chase begins.
Play aggressively rather than stealthily to save time; use Dead Eye on groups to get the triple kill and headshots.
Dead Eye restoratives are allowed; only health items are forbidden.

missions.name: Who the Hell is Leviticus Cornwall?
goldRequirements: Save Lenny when he is hanging from the train
After stopping the train, take out the guards within 1 minute 30 seconds
Take no damage during the shootout
Get 10 headshots
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Stay in cover and use Dead Eye constantly for the headshots and the timed guard fight.
Prioritise guards who climb or flank to avoid taking damage.
missableNotes: Documents 'Mining Company Letter to Cornwall' and 'Oil Company Letter to Cornwall' must be picked up during this mission (single source: cb).

missions.name: Eastward Bound
missions.spoilerFreeTitle: Wagon ride out of the mountains
goldRequirements: Pick up Javier when entering Horseshoe Overlook
Complete within 6 minutes
goldTips: Fix the wagon wheel quickly, skip cutscenes and keep the wagon/horse at speed the whole way.
missableNotes: Chapter 1 ends; Colter camp is left behind. Chapter 1 has no other known missables beyond the Cornwall documents.

missions.name: Polite Society, Valentine Style
missions.startLocation: Horseshoe Overlook camp, ride to Valentine
goldRequirements: Return the lost wagon horse to its owner
Find Karen within 45 seconds
goldTips: Help the stranded wagon owner by bringing back the loose horse when the prompt appears.
When the girls need finding, move straight to the objective (alley, then hotel) without detours.

missions.name: Americans at Rest
goldRequirements: Save Javier within 15 seconds
Defeat Tommy within 1 minute 30 seconds
goldTips: React immediately when Javier is held up.
In the fistfight, block and counter-attack rather than trading blows.

missions.name: Exit Pursued by a Bruised Ego
goldRequirements: Track the bear within 1 minute 30 seconds
Shoot the bear at least 6 times
Complete within 12 minutes
goldTips: Skip cutscenes and do the crafting/cooking steps quickly.
Use Dead Eye on the bear to land the 6 hits before it goes down.

missions.name: Paying a Social Call
goldRequirements: Silently kill 4 O'Driscolls
Get 12 headshots
Complete with at least 80% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Use the bow, throwing knives or melee takedowns for the silent kills before the shooting starts.
Use Dead Eye liberally for headshots and accuracy.

missions.name: A Quiet Time
goldRequirements: Try to make amends with an old rival
Catch Lenny in the act
Don't get arrested
goldTips: During the drinking section, seek out Tommy in the saloon and interact with him repeatedly.
At the end, flee the lawmen and leave Valentine instead of fighting them.

missions.name: Who is Not without Sin
goldRequirements: Win 2 hands of Poker
Return the Reverend to camp within 2 minutes 5 seconds
goldTips: Keep playing after the poker tutorial until you have won two hands.
Carry a Horse Stimulant for the timed ride back to camp.

missions.name: The Spines of America
goldRequirements: Loot everything from Carmody Dell
Don't get spotted
Deliver the wagon to Emerald Ranch within 1 minute 10 seconds
goldTips: Go at night; search every drawer, chest and surface in the house.
On the return, follow the marked road without stopping.

missions.name: Money Lending and Other Sins - I & II
goldTips: No gold medal for this mission part; only one debtor needs to be collected to progress.
missableNotes: Optional mission line; only available in Chapter 2 (listed as a Chapter 2 missable by cb and px).

missions.name: Money Lending and Other Sins - III
goldRequirements: Complete within 2 minutes 10 seconds
goldTips: Skip cutscenes and ride hard; this is purely a speed objective.
missableNotes: Chapter 2 only.

missions.name: Blessed are the Meek?
missions.startLocation: Horseshoe Overlook camp, ride to Strawberry
goldRequirements: While escaping, kill all mounted Lawmen within 55 seconds
Get 15 headshots
Complete with at least 70% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Use Dead Eye throughout; restore Dead Eye (not health) with items if needed.
During the horseback escape, headshot the pursuing lawmen quickly in Dead Eye to beat 55 seconds.

missions.name: The First Shall Be Last
missions.startLocation: Horseshoe Overlook camp, ride north of Blackwater
goldRequirements: Silently kill the Bounty Hunters by the river with Javier
Shoot the rope to free Sean
Get 10 headshots
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Use throwing knives or stealth takedowns for the two riverside hunters.
In the firefight, take out the sniper on the water tower first; use Dead Eye for headshots and the rope shot.
missableNotes: Unlocks Javier's companion activity to rescue Bill (deadline end of Chapter 4 per cb).

missions.name: Pouring Forth Oil - I
goldTips: No gold medal for part I (it is just the conversation that sets up part II).

missions.name: Pouring Forth Oil - II
goldRequirements: Deliver the wagon to the drop off within 1 minute 45 seconds
goldTips: Take the wagon at night, kill pursuers quickly and keep the wagon at full speed on the road.

missions.name: A Fisher of Men
goldRequirements: After arriving at the river, catch a fish within 1 minute 30 seconds
Complete within 7 minutes 20 seconds
goldTips: Skip cutscenes; cast straight away toward splashes in the water. No combat in this mission.

missions.name: Pouring Forth Oil - III
goldTips: No separate gold medal listed for part III (PowerPyx lists only II and IV).

missions.name: Pouring Forth Oil - IV
goldRequirements: Kill all the train guards before Sean fires a shot
Clear the baggage car of loot
Escape the Law within 1 minute 30 seconds
Get 10 kills in Dead Eye
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Move fast at the start so the guards are dead before Sean shoots.
Baggage car loot spots include cabinets behind the left door, a right-hand shelf, a green cabinet, a cabinet above the mail bags and a chest near the back door.
Change cover when the second guard wave arrives; use Dead Eye for the 10 Dead Eye kills.

missions.name: We Loved Once and True - I & II
goldTips: No gold medal for parts I and II; only part III has objectives.
missableNotes: Optional; Chapter 2 only (cb). Must be done to reach part III.

missions.name: We Loved Once and True - III
missions.startLocation: Horseshoe Overlook camp (letter), meet near Valentine
goldRequirements: Peacefully convince the Chelonians to let you take Jamie
Return Jamie to Mary within 2 minutes
goldTips: Do not use violence; per rdr2.org answer the leader's questions with 'Undecided' then 'Purpose', and shoot the gun out of Jamie's hand rather than him.
Use a Horse Stimulant for the 2-minute ride back to Valentine station.
missableNotes: Optional; Chapter 2 only (cb).

missions.name: Good, Honest, Snake Oil
goldRequirements: Stop Benedict Allbright falling off the cliff
Hogtie Allbright within 1 minute 15 seconds
Return Allbright to the sheriff within 1 minute 30 seconds
goldTips: Allbright does not run at first, so no sneaking is needed; approach and act promptly.
Use a Horse Stimulant for the timed return.
missableNotes: Optional honour-style mission (gtab, px).

missions.name: The Sheep and the Goats
goldRequirements: Herd all the sheep in to the pen in Valentine
Get 25 headshots
Complete with at least 70% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Buy a strong rifle (rdr2.org suggests the Rolling Block) beforehand.
Stay behind the flock and use the shout to push them; do not fire near the sheep.
Use Dead Eye liberally in the shootout and watch balconies/rooftops.
missableNotes: Conservative deadline for Chapter 2 missables (cb): companion activities (Charles hunting, Javier home robbery, Lenny five finger fillet), Chapter-2-only item requests, Money Lending I-III, We Loved Once and True I-III, Pouring Forth Oil II, Charity Handbill and Dutch's Speech Notes documents, antique watch in Wrobel's house.

missions.name: An American Pastoral Scene
goldRequirements: Headshot each of the mounted guards protecting the wagon
Get 10 kills in Dead Eye
Complete within 6 minutes
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Use Dead Eye for every mounted guard; skip cutscenes to stay under 6 minutes.

missions.name: A Strange Kindness
goldRequirements: Return the captive to his family within 1 minute 40 seconds
Get 5 headshots
Complete with at least 80% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Spot riders from range and use Dead Eye for clean headshots.
Ride straight back with a Horse Stimulant ready.
missableNotes: Final Chapter 2 mission; the gang then moves camp to Clemens Point and Chapter 2 camp content ends.

missions.name: The New South
missions.spoilerFreeTitle: Chasing a fugitive onto a train
goldRequirements: Knock out Anders Anderson without taking a hit
Catch and return Anders Anderson to jail within 5 minutes 30 seconds
Catch a fish with Dutch and Hosea
goldTips: Board the train fast; block and counter in the fight so you take no hits.
Ride directly to the Rhodes sheriff; afterwards land a fish during the fishing scene.

missions.name: Further Questions of Female Suffrage
goldRequirements: Fend off the Lemoyne Raiders in less than 1 minute
Get 5 headshots
Complete with at least 85% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Use Dead Eye for fast headshots from the wagon, then cover when raiders dismount.

missions.name: American Distillation
goldRequirements: Win the race back to camp
Complete the mission without taking any damage
Get 10 headshots
Complete with at least 70% accuracy
goldTips: Use cover and Dead Eye so you take zero damage.
Keep horse stamina up for the race.

missions.name: An Honest Mistake
goldRequirements: Save Uncle when he is overpowered
Get 20 headshots
Complete with at least 80% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Use Dead Eye frequently in the chase and barn fight; a scoped rifle helps with headshots.

missions.name: The Course of True Love - I
goldTips: No gold medal for part I (PowerPyx lists only II and III).
missableNotes: Optional; Chapter 3 only. Deadline disputed (see disputes).

missions.name: The Course of True Love - II
missions.spoilerFreeTitle: Sneaking a message to a lover
goldRequirements: Reach Penelope without getting spotted
Complete within 3 minutes
goldTips: Considered one of the hardest golds: skip cutscenes, stay mounted, cut across fields and watch enemy vision cones on the minimap.
missableNotes: Optional; Chapter 3 only.

missions.name: The Course of True Love - III
goldRequirements: Complete within 4 minutes 15 seconds
goldTips: Skip every cutscene and ride fast when mounted.
missableNotes: Optional; Chapter 3 only.

missions.name: Money Lending and Other Sins - IV
goldTips: No gold medal. Debtors are in Rhodes and north of Strawberry.
missableNotes: Optional; Chapter 3 only (cb, gr).

missions.name: Preaching Forgiveness as He Went
goldRequirements: Kill 10 Lemoyne Raiders with a long scoped rifle
Complete within 11 minutes 30 seconds
Complete with at least 70% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Skip cutscenes; snipe from range first, then switch weapons as enemies close in.

missions.name: Sodom? Back to Gomorrah
goldRequirements: Loot all the safes
Headshot 5 mounted Lawmen during the horseback escape
Get to Downes Ranch within 1 minute 55 seconds
Complete with at least 70% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Crack every safe (turn the stick until it vibrates, alternating direction).
Use Dead Eye for the mounted headshots and a Horse Stimulant for the ride to Downes Ranch.

missions.name: Advertising, the New American Art - I
goldTips: No gold medal for part I (PowerPyx lists only part II).

missions.name: Advertising, the New American Art - II
goldRequirements: Headshot 5 Lemoyne Raiders in the saloon
Complete with at least 90% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Few enemies; stay in Dead Eye for every shot to protect the 90% accuracy.

missions.name: Magicians for Sport
goldRequirements: Inspect all the clues in Trelawny's Caravan
While tracking, stay within 30 feet of the Trelawny's trail
Kill 2 Bounty Hunters in the cornfields within 1 minute
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Examine every highlighted clue in the caravan before leaving.
Watch for birds flying up to locate hunters in the corn, or snipe from the nearby hill.
missableNotes: Loot the Rare Rolling Block Rifle from the bounty hunter sniper during this mission or it is lost (cb, gr, px).
Mine Share document in Trelawny's caravan is only obtainable in this mission (cb, gr).

missions.name: Horse Flesh for Dinner
goldRequirements: Kill the stable hand showing you the horses
Catch the stallion within 10 seconds
Get 5 headshots
goldTips: A quiet takedown on the stable hand avoids drawing attention.
Have the lasso ready and act at once when the stallion bolts; Dead Eye makes the headshots easy.

missions.name: Friends in Very Low Places
goldRequirements: Complete the mission without being spotted
Complete within 8 minutes 10 seconds
goldTips: Skip cutscenes; wait for the driver to step away before opening the lockbox.

missions.name: The Fine Joys of Tobacco
goldRequirements: Silently kill the Gray Sean distracts in the wagon store
Douse the fields within 2 minutes 20 seconds
Kill 5 Grays during the escape
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Choke/knife the distracted man silently and hide the body in the barn.
Move quickly between fields; use Dead Eye on pursuers during the escape.

missions.name: Blessed are the Peacemakers
goldRequirements: Free yourself and perform self-surgery within 1 minute
Recover your weapons from the O'Driscoll's camp
Kill the O'Driscoll gang members that beat and shot you
Escape the O'Driscoll's camp without being spotted
goldTips: Swing quickly to grab the file, then rotate the stick to treat the wound.
Use throwing knives/stealth on guards; collect weapons from the marked spots before leaving.
missableNotes: Game Rant: do the Sean + Mary-Beth coach robbery companion activity before starting this mission.

missions.name: A Short Walk in a Pretty Town
goldRequirements: Kill 3 Lawmen in Dead Eye while saving Bill
Complete using only sidearms
Complete within 4 minutes 30 seconds
Get 20 headshots
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Equip good revolvers/pistols beforehand, never switch to a long arm, and use Dead Eye constantly.
missableNotes: Game Rant says The Course of True Love I-III must be finished before this mission (see disputes).

missions.name: Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern
goldRequirements: Headshot Gareth and Gerald Braithwaite
Get 20 headshots
Complete with at least 85% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Stay in cover and fire only in Dead Eye for accuracy.
missableNotes: Gold Shield valuable and Letter to Angelo Bronte document are only obtainable during this mission (upstairs room at Braithwaite Manor; cb, gr).
Game Rant also lists a Braithwaite Brooch looted in connection with this mission.

This is the deadline (cb) for Chapter 3 companion activities (Bill/Sean coach robberies, Sean home robbery, Javier and Kieran fishing, Micah five finger fillet, Tilly dominoes), Chapter-3-only item requests (Hosea ginseng, Kieran burdock root, Molly pocket mirror, Tilly necklace), Money Lending IV and The Course of True Love I-III.
It leads straight into the chapter finale.

missions.name: The Battle of Shady Belle
goldRequirements: Kill all the Lemoyne Raiders in Shady Belle
Clear two bodies from Shady Belle within 1 minute 40 seconds
Complete within 11 minutes
goldTips: Skip cutscenes and use a shotgun for fast room clearing; carry the bodies out immediately.
missableNotes: Final Chapter 3 mission; camp moves and Chapter 4 (Saint Denis area) begins.

missables.what: Mining Company Letter to Cornwall and Oil Company Letter to Cornwall (documents)
missables.deadline: During 'Who the Hell is Leviticus Cornwall?' (Chapter 1)
missables.recommendedTiming: Search the train cars during the mission.
howTo: Loot the documents inside the train during the robbery before leaving.

missables.what: Chapter 2 companion activities: Charles hunting, Javier home robbery, Lenny five finger fillet
missables.deadline: Before starting 'The Sheep and the Goats' (conservative; chapter ends after 'A Strange Kindness')
missables.recommendedTiming: Mid Chapter 2 while free-roaming between story missions; check camp regularly.
missables.why: Companion-activity trophy tracking; these are tied to the Horseshoe Overlook camp.
howTo: Return to camp in daytime and look for the companion-activity prompt when talking to these characters.

missables.what: Chapter-2-only camp item requests (e.g. Abigail $5, Jack comic book and thimble, Javier oleander sage, Mary-Beth fountain pen, Sean Kentucky bourbon, Pearson unskinned rabbit)
missables.deadline: Before starting 'The Sheep and the Goats' (conservative)
missables.recommendedTiming: Deliver as soon as each request appears in Chapter 2.
missables.why: Item requests count toward the item-request trophy; several are limited to Chapter 2 (others run through Chapter 4).
howTo: Talk to camp members to trigger requests, gather the item, and hand it over in camp.

missables.what: Optional Chapter 2 mission lines: Money Lending and Other Sins I-III, We Loved Once and True I-III, Good, Honest, Snake Oil
missables.deadline: End of Chapter 2 (cb lists 'The Sheep and the Goats' as deadline)
missables.recommendedTiming: Before the last two or three Chapter 2 missions.
missables.why: Story-mission completion and gold medals (MLAOS III, WLOAT III and Snake Oil carry medals).
howTo: Pick up the Strauss/Hosea missions in camp, read Mary's letter in Arthur's tent, and take the bounty from the Valentine sheriff.

missables.what: Charity Handbill (Thomas Downes' table in Valentine), Dutch's Speech Notes (near broken wagon at Horseshoe Overlook), Antique Watch (Wrobel's house drawer)
howTo: Pick up each item at the listed location during Chapter 2.

missables.what: Chapter 3 companion activities: Bill coach robbery, Sean coach robbery, Sean home robbery, Javier fishing, Kieran fishing, Micah five finger fillet, Tilly dominoes
missables.deadline: Before 'Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern' (Sean coach robbery: before 'Blessed are the Peacemakers' per gr)
missables.recommendedTiming: Early-mid Chapter 3, before the Peacemakers mission.
missables.why: Companion-activity trophy tracking; tied to Clemens Point camp.
howTo: Talk to these characters in camp and accept their activity invitations.

missables.what: Chapter-3-only item requests: Hosea 2x American Ginseng, Kieran 2x Burdock Root, Molly Pocket Mirror, Tilly Necklace
missables.recommendedTiming: As soon as requested in Chapter 3.
howTo: Ginseng grows in south Lemoyne; burdock near water; the pocket mirror is at Martha's Swain (per gr).

missables.what: Money Lending and Other Sins IV; The Course of True Love I-III
missables.deadline: Before 'Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern' (cb); Game Rant says True Love must be done before 'A Short Walk in a Pretty Town'
missables.recommendedTiming: Do them before 'A Short Walk in a Pretty Town' to be safe.
missables.why: Story completion; True Love II and III carry gold medals.
howTo: Talk to Strauss in camp; meet Beau Gray near Caliga Hall.

missables.what: Rare Rolling Block Rifle and Mine Share document
missables.recommendedTiming: Loot the sniper bounty hunter in the cornfield/barn and search Trelawny's caravan.
missables.why: Unique weapon and document not obtainable later.
howTo: Kill the bounty hunter sniper, loot his rifle, and pick up the mine share inside the caravan.

missables.what: Gold Shield valuable and Letter to Angelo Bronte
missables.recommendedTiming: Grab them inside Braithwaite Manor during the mission.
howTo: Search the room with the fireplace upstairs in the manor during the mission.

notes: All gold-medal objectives for a mission must be achieved in a single run; checkpoint reloads reset counters. Save manually before each story mission on the first playthrough; Replay Mission uses fixed loadouts and is harder. (sources: ppx)
Only health items are banned by 'no health items' objectives; Dead Eye restoratives are allowed. (sources: rdr2org-ch1, rdr2org-ch2)
Timed objectives include cutscenes; skip cutscenes to save time. (sources: rdr2org-ch2, rdr2org-ch3)
Gold Rush needs 70 of 104 story-mission golds, so hard ones (e.g. The Course of True Love II) can be skipped. (sources: ppx)

Chapters 2 (Horseshoe Overlook) and 3 (Clemens Point) are the open, free-roam heavy chapters: story missions are started from icons at will, and companion activities and item requests belong to that chapter's camp, so return to camp between missions. Chapter 1 is linear. (sources: px, cb)

Missions without a gold medal in Ch1-3: Money Lending and Other Sins I & II, IV; We Loved Once and True I & II; Pouring Forth Oil I & III; The Course of True Love I; Advertising, the New American Art I. rdr2.org confirms no medal for Money Lending; the others are inferred from PowerPyx listing only the other parts. (sources: ppx, rdr2org-ch2, rdr2org-ch3)
No Chapter-2-only legendary animal was found in the sources checked; the Chapter 2 missables are camp activities, item requests, optional mission lines and documents. (sources: cb, px)

disputes.details: Chapters 2 and 3 are non-linear; guides list missions in different orders.

positions.claim: PowerPyx order (used here): Polite Society, Americans at Rest, Exit Pursued, Paying a Social Call, A Quiet Time, Who is Not without Sin, Spines of America, Money Lending, Blessed are the Meek?, First Shall Be Last, Pouring Forth Oil, ... A Strange Kindness last.
Other guides use orders such as Who is Not without Sin third, or The New South before Further Questions of Female Suffrage in Chapter 3.

disputes.suggestedHandling: Show order as a recommendation. Only fixed points: Polite Society first; The Sheep and the Goats, then A Strange Kindness, end Chapter 2; Blood Feuds, then The Battle of Shady Belle, end Chapter 3.

disputes.topic: Accuracy percentages in some medal requirements
disputes.details: GamesHedge gives 75% instead of 70% (Blessed are the Meek?, The Sheep and the Goats, American Distillation, Preaching Forgiveness, Sodom? Back to Gomorrah) and 80% instead of 85% (Further Questions of Female Suffrage, Blood Feuds).

positions.claim: 70% / 85% values
75% / 80% values

disputes.suggestedHandling: Use the PowerPyx values (70% / 85%), which three sources back. Tell players to aim above 85% anyway.

disputes.topic: Which mission parts have gold medals / total gold-medal missions
disputes.details: GTABase marks grouped entries (Money Lending I & II, Pouring Forth Oil I & II, etc.) as having gold objectives and says 105 missions have gold medals. rdr2.org says Money Lending has no gold medal, and PowerPyx counts 104.

positions.claim: 104 gold-medal missions; Money Lending I/II/IV and the first parts of multi-part missions have no medal
105 missions with gold objectives

disputes.suggestedHandling: Use 104 and mark the listed parts as 'no medal'. The gold count needed for the trophy is 70 either way.

disputes.topic: Total story missions in game and per-chapter counts

positions.claim: 104 story missions for 100% (and Ch2 = 18, Ch3 = 17 medal missions)
110 story missions incl. 19 optional honour missions; Ch2 = 19 and Ch3 = 18 entries (grouped)
Grouped quest list: Ch2 = 16, Ch3 = 16
Chapter 3 has 18 story missions

disputes.suggestedHandling: Enforce only the gold-medal counts (6 / 18 / 17 = 41 for Ch1-3). Present the story-mission total as 'about 104 (counting varies)'.

disputes.topic: Exit Pursued by a Bruised Ego objectives
disputes.details: rdr2.org lists only the 12-minute and 6-shots objectives.

positions.claim: Three objectives incl. 'Track the bear within 1:30'
Two objectives

disputes.topic: Wording of A Quiet Time objectives
disputes.details: rdr2.org paraphrases 'make amends' as interacting with Tommy several times in the saloon.

positions.claim: Make amends with an old rival; catch Lenny in the act; don't get arrested
Interact with Tommy four times; avoid arrest

disputes.suggestedHandling: Use the PowerPyx wording, and add the Tommy tip as how to do it.

positions.claim: Ch2 deadline 'The Sheep and the Goats'; Ch3 deadline 'Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern' for companion activities, requests, Money Lending IV and True Love
The Course of True Love before 'A Short Walk in a Pretty Town'; Sean coach robbery before 'Blessed are the Peacemakers'
Before the chapter's final group of missions

disputes.suggestedHandling: Use the earliest deadline: finish Ch2 extras before The Sheep and the Goats, and Ch3 extras before Blessed are the Peacemakers.

disputes.details: Most givers and start locations come only from rdr2.org summaries. Some (e.g. Horse Flesh for Dinner: Tavish Gray; American Distillation: Rhodes sheriff's office; Who is Not without Sin: Flatneck Station) were not cross-checked.

positions.claim: Givers as recorded

disputes.suggestedHandling: Show the mission icon's chapter camp as the default start. Treat named givers as secondary info.

disputes.topic: Pouring Forth Oil II listed as missable
disputes.details: Codeberg lists Pouring Forth Oil II among Chapter 2 missable missions, but PowerPyx says The Sheep and the Goats unlocks after Pouring Forth Oil IV, which suggests the chain is required.

positions.claim: Pouring Forth Oil II is missable
The Pouring Forth Oil chain leads into the chapter finale (GTABase marks only I & II as optional)

disputes.suggestedHandling: Tell players to finish all Pouring Forth Oil parts in Chapter 2.
